source: The Buildings of Alden B. Dow, Built Projects, p. 214
cross_referenced_with: abdow.org (Alden B. Dow Home & Studio archive) and Google Places

records.notes: Addition to a manse (minister's residence). No abdow page exists for this minor 1937 work. The Midland Presbyterian congregation is Memorial Presbyterian Church (organized 1867); coords are that church as a proxy. The manse is a residence whose specific 1937 location is unverified and may differ. Footnote 1 unknown.

records.structure_name: Reorganized Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
records.notes: Dow's first religious structure (design begun Feb 1940), corner of Ashman and Mertz. Per abdow, Christ Covenant Church is the current (second) owner; survives as 'Midland's first Mid-Century Modern church.'
No dedicated abdow page surfaced; identity and address well established.

records.matched_name: Cross in the Woods Catholic Shrine
records.notes: abdow confirms the 1948 cinder-block church (230 ft with rectory) overlooking Burt Lake, completed Memorial Day 1949; Dow also designed the 1955 hillside crucifix with sculptor Marshall Fredericks. This is the Cross in the Woods shrine site.

Confirmed via the parish and Mid-Century Modern Midland: Dow sketches Oct 1949, built 1951, first services Aug 1952. No abdow.org page surfaced (MCMM has a listing). Address 405 N Saginaw Rd confirmed.

records.matched_address: 24 Fountain St NE, Grand Rapids, MI 49503
records.notes: Year inferred from column continuation under 1949. No dedicated abdow page surfaced. Congregation now styled 'Fountain Street Church'.

records.structure_name: St. John's Episcopal Church Parsonage and Apartment
records.notes: Parsonage/apartment on the St. John's Episcopal site; same coords as the church (built 1951, first services 1952).
The building pictured atop the source page. Octagonal 'Luther rose' plan, designed 1953; Dow-designed addition completed 1963. Still St. John's Lutheran.

records.matched_name: New Life Vineyard Church (former East Ashman Street Church of God)
records.notes: Per abdow ('East Ashman Street Church of God'): designed 1953, contracts Nov 1955, balcony 1963. Significantly enlarged/altered; now the New Life Vineyard Church. Footnote 2 unknown.

records.matched_address: 501 S Catherine St, Bay City, MI 48706
records.notes: abdow: Dow selected by the building committee in 1954, one year after St. John's Lutheran; brick building around a landscaped courtyard. Still Messiah Lutheran.
abdow: designed from 1955 (early Star-of-David scheme), completed 1961 as Temple Israel; after a 2010 merger with Saginaw's Congregation Beth El, Dow's building is now Temple Beth Israel.

records.matched_name: United Methodist Church of the Dunes
records.notes: Confirmed as the 'Methodist Church of the Dunes,' set into the dunes overlooking Lake Michigan. abdow dates design 1957, completion Feb 1961; the book groups it under 1955 (commission-vs-completion). Still active.

No abdow page; abdow notes Dow designed only two Jewish 'temples' (Bay City and Spring Valley), so the 1957 Midland work was minor alterations to the existing Jewish center. Midland's Jewish congregation is Temple Beth El, used here as the proxy; whether the 1957 center occupied this Bay City Rd site is unverified. Distinct from the Spring Valley, NY Temple Beth El below.

records.matched_name: Original Livonia building; congregation since relocated
records.matched_address: Farmington Rd & Six Mile Rd area, Livonia, MI (approx.)
records.notes: No abdow page. Congregation began 1956 in Livonia and built the Dow church near Farmington Rd & Six Mile Rd; the Detroit/Livonia 'Ward Memorial' entity dissolved 1982. Successor 'Ward Church' (EPC) later moved to Northville (6 Mile & Haggerty) and Farmington Hills, so those coords are NOT this building. Original building's present status unverified; coords left blank. Footnote 3 unknown.
No abdow page and no confident place match; name is ambiguous (possibly First Christian Church / Disciples of Christ, or a Christian Reformed congregation). Coords left blank.
abdow: congregation's RFP April 1958; Dow selected. Still Eastminster Presbyterian at 1315 Abbot Rd.
Year inferred from column continuation under 1958; abdow notes cornerstone sealed Sept 14, 1960. Still Christ Episcopal.

Confirmed via Mid-Century Modern Midland: prelim drawings June 1959, final Sept 1960, for the congregation that grew out of St. John's Episcopal. No abdow.org page surfaced. Address 4611 Swede Ave confirmed.
abdow: congregation approved Dow Jan 21, 1960; dedicated Jan 24, 1965. Triangular columns. Still First Presbyterian of Dearborn.
No dedicated abdow page surfaced; identity and address well established (an addition to the existing church).

Corrected: abdow states the Citadel 'is currently the home of Creative 360,' a community arts and wellness nonprofit. Planning began 1961, drawings June 1962, dedicated April 1963 (book groups under 1960). NOT the current Salvation Army corps on Waldo Ave.
Confirmed as a Dow building via abdow's archive (its 'beehive light and sound tower' is featured); no standalone project page surfaced. Still First Congregational, 109 S Main St.
abdow: Pastor D.E. Howe contacted Dow early 1961; drawings 1963, contract Jan 1964. Still Midland Seventh-day Adventist.

Year inferred from column continuation under 1961. Dow's only built work in NY; correspondence began 1960, dedicated 1965. abdow notes the congregation's decline forced a merger/relocation by ~2015, so verify the current occupant of 415 Viola Rd (the Dow building's address).

records.structure_name: Church of the Nazarene addition (Nease Memorial)
records.matched_name: Nease Memorial Church of the Nazarene
records.notes: abdow: congregation organized Jan 29, 1961; Dow drawings Oct 1961, built by volunteer labor 1961-62. Western edge of Midland. Still Nease Memorial.

records.structure_name: Hellenic Orthodox Community Church of St. George
records.notes: abdow: designed 1962; barrel-vault roof, icon screen by Midland artist Charles Breed. abdow lists it as Bloomfield Hills; current address is Bloomfield Township, 43816 Woodward Ave. Still St. George Greek Orthodox.

records.structure_name: Lutheran Church, Missouri Synod Michigan District Headquarters
records.matched_name: Michigan District of The Lutheran Church-Missouri Synod
records.notes: No dedicated abdow project page surfaced; identity and address well established. Still the LCMS Michigan District office.
